what: a 100 x 40 blank with two 15 x 7 tabs on one line, one tab folded 90 degrees on a line that the other tab also lies on
method: blank area 100*40 + 2*15*7 = 4210 mm2 at t = 0.8; the one fold (width 7, R = t = 0.8, K = 0.44): a fold keeps the flat length of the blank, so a fold of angle th, inner radius R, thickness t and K-factor K over a width w takes a flat strip of BA = th(R+Kt) and puts a bend of volume th((R+t)^2-R^2)w/2 in its place: V = V_flat + th w t^2 (1/2 - K) (the bend's mid-surface lies at R+t/2, the neutral axis at R+Kt). V = 4210*0.8 + (pi/2)*7*0.64*0.06
